title: SensAiry open protocol
notes: The published SensAiry open protocol (tymtix.com/open-protocol, read 2026-11-18): a 19-byte non-connectable advertisement counted from its first byte: 0-2 flags, 3 length, 4 type 0xFF, 5-6 company id (shown only as 0xXXXX; BA06 is assumed from the SRS), 7 vendor id, 8 model id, 9-14 sensor id (printed on the sensor), 15 battery (/10 V), 16 temperature (degC, signed byte: the page says the top bit is the sign, and its example 0xFA = -6 is two's complement; -20..105), 17-18 pressure (kPa, big-endian, 0-700). The payload here starts after the company id, so A = byte 7. The page says this applies only to sensors sold as open protocol (India, 4W internal); other SensAiry models may use the layout in sensairy.json. Marked 'inferred' until a capture from the car matches the sensor app.
